_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC, hand-built from Atlas-class ascent numbers: a 28-tonne launch vehicle through max q, 3.7 m core so 10.75 m² of reference area. A rocket has no wing area for a stall fraction to be a fraction of and no lift the model reports, so four fields are genuinely absent, and the tick shown is the one just after a separation with the aerodynamics model not yet rebuilt.
_meta.sources: Reference area is the frontal disc of a 3.7 m core; ballistic coefficient is m/(Cd·A) for the same mass, area and Cd 0.31.
